law: REGISTRATION of E-Q38 — THE DRIFT MONITOR, r28 reading (ORCH-R28 lane T19-d): the standing instrument's FOURTH reading (r24 sealed baseline / r25 / r26 / r28 — the r27 reading deferred with receipt for temporal spacing, honored by this session boundary). 20 records re-embedded through the byte-identical 8-question map; per-axis movement vs all three sealed baselines; model_served as the version-flip readout. The band (<= 0.10) has held three readings; a fourth extends the time series across a session boundary — the longest spacing yet.
provenance_of_the_question: The standing instrument (E-Q31 registration; readings r25/r26/r28). The r27 deferral receipt: same-session spacing defeats the instrument; this reading is the first to cross a full session boundary.

design_frozen.calls: One batched 12-question call per record — the byte-identical E-Q25 map (8 real + 4 decoys) over all 20 sealed records, jev-latest, 20 calls, AS-SAID rows, resume law. The 8-real-axis answers are the drift reading; the 4 decoy answers ride along as the in-call floor check (the r25 pattern).
design_frozen.measures: M1 per (record, axis): movement vs the sealed r24, r25, r26 vectors (max, mean, within-0.10 count). M2 model_served (the version-flip readout). M3 the three-point trend: is r28-vs-r26 mean larger than r26-vs-r24 (a walk) or flat (sampling noise around a fixed point)? M4 the decoy floor (in-call, 80 readings).

floors.F1: the question map byte-identical to E-Q25/E-Q31 (sha asserted in code)
floors.F2: all 20 records, byte-identical texts (from the sealed corpus file)
floors.F3: one batched call per record, all 12 answers present, p in [0,1]
floors.F4: comparison against the sealed r24/r25/r26 vectors only (no re-derived baselines)

hypotheses.H1_band: all 20 records within 0.10 on all 8 axes vs the r26 baseline (the band holds across a session boundary)
hypotheses.H2_version: model_served unchanged from jev-1.13.0 — OR the flip is receipted with the full per-axis delta table (either direction is the instrument doing its job)
hypotheses.C36: the drift band holds at the fourth reading with the longest spacing — LIVES iff H1 AND H2

predictions.P1: max movement <= 0.08 (slightly tighter than r26's 0.08; no version flip)
predictions.P2: r28-vs-r26 mean within 1.5x of r26-vs-r24 mean (flat trend — the fixed point holds)
predictions.P3: decoy floor mean <= 0.03 (the canaries stay dead)

falsifier: ANY of F1-F4 breached; the map sha mismatch; comparison against re-derived instead of sealed vectors.
budget: 20 typesafe calls. Part of the r28 round budget.
